item: Project skeleton with CI and Flyway
acceptance_criteria: Given a fresh clone, when mvnw verify runs, then the build and tests are green in CI
Given valid data, when I register, then my account is created and I can log in
Given valid credentials, when I log in, then I receive a token that expires after 12 h

item: Role checks for instructor and student pages
acceptance_criteria: Given I am a student, when I open an instructor page, then access is refused

item: Create quiz with title and description
acceptance_criteria: Given I am an instructor, when I save a quiz, then it appears in my quiz list

item: Add edit reorder and delete questions
acceptance_criteria: Given a quiz, when I add and reorder questions, then the order is saved and shown
Given a question, when I mark one or several answers correct, then both types are stored
